item.title: Travel Wedding Show to Bring Global Wedding Destinations and Indian Planners Together
item.description: The Travel Wedding Show, organised by Travel Show India, is a curated B2B platform designed to connect global destinations, hospitality brands, and wedding service providers with India’s leading destination wedding planners. item.title: Arunachal Fashion Week 2026 to Showcase Indigenous Textiles and Creative Economy Vision
item.description: Arunachal Fashion Week 2026 will be held from March 14–21 in Naharlagun, showcasing indigenous textiles, designer collaborations and artisan entrepreneurship as part of the state’s creative economy push.

item.title: Tehri Lake Festival Inaugurated by CM of Uttarakhand, State Pushes Global Tourism Vision
item.description: Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami inaugurated the Himalayan O₂ – Tehri Lake Festival, highlighting Uttarakhand’s vision to develop Tehri as a global destination for tourism and adventure sports.

item.title: Banyan Tree Events Presents ‘Symphony of Santoor – Echoes of Serenity’ to Bring Indo-Orchestral Collaboration to Mumbai
item.description: “Symphony of Santoor – Echoes of Serenity” will feature Rahul Shivkumar Sharma performing with a 35-member chamber orchestra conducted by Samuel Tamarit Otero in Mumbai.

item.title: Kiara Becomes Only Indian Female Artist Performing at ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: Artist and music producer Kiara is performing at the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, becoming the only Indian female artist selected for the tournament’s in-stadium entertainment stage.

item.title: Skål International India Showcases Strategic Engagement at OTM Mumbai and SATTE Delhi
item.description: Skål International India strengthened its industry engagement with a strategic presence at OTM Mumbai and SATTE New Delhi, hosting networking sessions and advancing national tourism collaborations.

item.title: Back Of House India Executes High-Impact Launch for Ashok Leyland’s TAURUS and HIPPO Trailers
item.description: Back Of House India managed the production and technical execution of Ashok Leyland’s launch event for the TAURUS and HIPPO trailers, delivering a high-impact showcase with seamless event coordination.

item.title: Zee Live Brings Onboard Cherish Nair to Shape Brand Narratives and Marketing Strategy
item.description: Cherish Nair has joined Zee Live as Brand and Marketing Consultant, where she will focus on building brand narratives and audience engagement for the company’s cultural and entertainment experiences.

item.title: Karan Aujla and Team Innovation Offer Complimentary Mumbai 2.0 Concert to Original Ticket Holders After Holi Show
item.description: Karan Aujla and Team Innovation have announced a special return concert in Mumbai on April 12, offering complimentary access to fans who attended the March 3 Holi show.

item.title: Hero MotoCorp Hosts ‘SheRidesForSafety’ Women’s Night Rally Promoting Safer Mobility
item.description: Hero MotoCorp organised the ‘SheRidesForSafety’ women’s night rally under its RideSafeIndia initiative, bringing together over 200 riders to promote safer mobility and road safety awareness.
